summary: Iteration 17 — Backend pytest 23/23 PASSED. Frontend Playwright verified: Home gallery has 5 items, admin login OK, AdminCategories shows 6 defaults (Sub-8..Sub-18) with inline editing, AdminEventTypes shows Festival/Premier seeds, AdminInventory has 4 tabs [lodging, meal_addon, transport, tour], 'Valor Paquete (COP)' label appears 2x and 'Base 5 noches' removed (0 occurrences), meal_addon Add modal exposes inv-new-name/inv-new-meal-type/inv-new-meal-class/inv-new-cost, tour rows have inv-tour-desc-* and Add Tour modal has inv-new-tour-desc, AdminTournaments 'Nuevo evento' modal has 'Tipo de evento' selector [tour-event-type], 'Categorías inscritas al evento' editor [categories-fees-editor] + [add-category-fee] button, and NO 'Categoría (principal)' label. CurrencyInput formats '1500000'→'1.500.000' correctly (es-CO, no decimals, no leading zeros).
action_items: (Optional) Home gallery auto-rotation: API returns 5 images but our screenshot-based src-comparison test was inconclusive (img src unchanged after 6.5s). Code at /app/frontend/src/pages/Home.jsx lines 43-54 looks correct (setInterval 5000ms, random idx with collision guard). Likely a test-selector issue (multiple img tags) rather than functional defect. Recommend manual verification or instrument GalleryCarousel with a data-testid on the active image for deterministic testing.
(Optional) Split server.py (3899 lines) into routers — same backlog note from iter 16.
critical_code_review_comments: _validate_catalog_row correctly uppercases meal_type and classification and rejects invalid meal_type with 400 — verified via pytest.
POST/PUT /api/teams now correctly accepts custom categories (validated 'Femenino' OK, empty string still rejected with 400).
Categories and event_types auto-seed on first admin GET — confirmed; admins see defaults immediately.
Tour catalog: description persists on POST and PUT — verified via /api/admin/catalog round-trip.

AdminInventory data-testid coverage is excellent: inv-tab-*, inv-add-*, inv-new-name, inv-new-meal-type, inv-new-meal-class, inv-new-cost, inv-new-tour-desc, inv-tour-desc-{id}, inv-meal_addon-{id} all present.
AdminTournaments removed legacy 'Categoría (principal)' input and now loads event_types and categories dynamically via /api/admin/event-types and /api/admin/categories — confirmed via DOM inspection.
CurrencyInput correctly produces es-CO thousands-dot format (1.500.000) without decimals — verified live in lodging base input.
server.py still imports CATEGORIES constant only as fallback for /api/categories when DB empty and for /api/import/teams validation — acceptable and consistent.
Home.jsx gallery rotation logic looks correct (5000ms interval, random idx with `if (next === prev) next = (prev + 1) % length` collision guard, and `if (gallery.length < 2) return;` guard).
